title: Trace the query path under pressure
description: Select a production scenario, follow the active path, and inspect each component. The result separates failures that need more capacity from failures that need a safer fallback or fresher data.

nodes.label: Search gateway
nodes.detail: Authenticates the request, assigns one end-to-end deadline, and records the query, treatment, locale, filters, and trace identifier.

nodes.label: Query understanding
nodes.detail: Normalizes text, extracts entities and hard filters, chooses retrieval routes, and preserves the original query for observability.

nodes.label: Lexical index
nodes.detail: Uses terms, fields, phrase matches, and filters to retrieve exact names, identifiers, and rare words with explainable scores.

nodes.label: Vector index
nodes.detail: Uses approximate nearest-neighbor search to find conceptually related items. Recall depends on the embedding, index parameters, filters, and candidate depth.

nodes.label: Fusion service
nodes.detail: Deduplicates lexical and semantic candidates, combines rank evidence, and emits a bounded set with source ranks and feature versions attached.

nodes.label: Learned reranker
nodes.detail: Scores only the bounded candidate set with richer query-document features. It must honor a strict timeout and return a deterministic fallback order.

nodes.label: Result assembler
nodes.detail: Applies permissions, availability, diversity, and deduplication; creates snippets; logs exposures; and returns the final page before the deadline.

scenarios.label: Healthy hybrid
scenarios.summary: Lexical and semantic retrieval finish inside their child deadlines, fusion preserves evidence from both, and the reranker returns before the response budget expires.
scenarios.result: Return the reranked page and log source ranks, model versions, timing, and exposure. This trace is the baseline for quality and latency comparisons.

scenarios.label: ANN degraded
scenarios.summary: The vector index exceeds its child deadline during a memory-pressure event. Lexical retrieval remains healthy and still provides exact-match candidates.
scenarios.result: Stop waiting at the vector deadline, mark semantic retrieval as missing, and continue with lexical candidates. Alert on semantic timeout rate and measure quality by query slice before restoring traffic.

scenarios.label: Reranker timeout
scenarios.summary: Both retrievers return useful candidates, but the learned reranker is slow after a model deployment and cannot finish inside its assigned budget.
scenarios.result: Return the deterministic fused order instead of an error or an empty page. Roll back or shed reranker traffic using model-version latency and timeout evidence.

scenarios.label: Indexing lag
scenarios.summary: Serving is fast, but the lexical and vector indexes contain different document versions after an ingestion backlog. Available items can disappear and deleted items can reappear.
scenarios.result: Fail closed on permissions and deletion state, expose index-version skew and freshness lag, and repair or replay the ingestion pipeline. Query replicas do not solve stale indexes.
